questions.q: What is the capital of Togo?
questions.why: It sits on the Ghana border.

questions.q: From which country did Togo gain independence in 1960?
questions.why: It had been a UN trust territory.

questions.q: Which country colonised Togo first, in 1884?
questions.why: It was called Togoland.

questions.q: Which family has ruled Togo since 1967?
questions.why: Faure Gnassingbé took over from his father.

questions.q: What is Togo's currency?
questions.why: It is shared by eight countries.

questions.q: Which ocean is on Togo's short coast?
questions.why: The coast is only about 56 km long.

questions.q: Who was the first President of Togo?
questions.why: He was killed in 1963.

questions.q: Who ruled Togo from 1967 to 2005?
questions.why: He was Africa's longest-serving leader at the time.

questions.q: Which part of German Togoland joined Ghana?
questions.why: It voted in 1956.

questions.q: Which 2024 change made Togo a parliamentary system?
questions.why: Faure Gnassingbé became President of the Council.

questions.q: Which lake town was the old German capital?
questions.why: It is on the coast.

questions.q: Which German-era royal treaty was signed at Togoville?
questions.why: It created the German protectorate in 1884.

questions.q: Which agreements between Europe and African countries were named after Lomé?
questions.why: The first was signed in 1975.

questions.q: Which Togolese leader overthrew Olympio in 1963?
questions.why: He was a sergeant then and took power himself in 1967.

questions.q: Which ethnic group lives mainly in southern Togo?
questions.why: Many Ewe also live in Ghana.

questions.q: Which mud tower houses of the Batammariba are a UNESCO site?
questions.why: They look like small castles.

questions.q: Which market in Lomé sells traditional remedies?
questions.why: It is one of the largest of its kind.

questions.q: Which footballer from Togo starred for Arsenal and Manchester City?
questions.why: He was African Player of the Year in 2008.

questions.q: What is Togo's national football team called?
questions.why: They played at the 2006 World Cup.

questions.q: Which lake near the coast is popular for boat trips?
questions.why: Togoville is on its shore.

questions.q: Which language is the official language of Togo?
questions.why: Ewe and Kabye are national languages.

questions.q: Which hilly town is known for waterfalls and butterflies?
questions.why: It is near Mount Agou.

questions.q: What is Togo's highest mountain?
questions.why: It is about 986 m high.

questions.q: Which canoeist won Togo's first Olympic medal, in 2008?
questions.why: He won bronze in slalom.

questions.q: Which festival of the Kabye people includes wrestling?
questions.why: Young men prove their strength.

questions.q: Which corn dough eaten with sauce is a Togolese staple?
questions.why: It is similar to Ghana's banku.

questions.q: What attacked Togo's team bus at the 2010 Africa Cup of Nations?
questions.why: Two staff members were killed.

questions.q: Which Togolese singer is called the 'King of Togolese music'?
questions.why: He sings in Ewe and Mina.

questions.q: Which is the largest national park in Togo?
questions.why: It is the largest park in Togo.

questions.q: Which singer from Togo was a 1960s star across Africa?
questions.why: She died young in 1973.
